ListItem.Para: Disconnect the wiring harness connector (1) from the catalytic convertor (2).

Graphic.entityref: Z:\VECV\SPINE\08 Pilot-work\02 Shop Manual\3019\From SME\Illustrations\5.6 Catalytic Convertor\21360026.jpg

Graphic.entityref: Z:\VECV\SPINE\08 Pilot-work\02 Shop Manual\3019\From SME\Illustrations\5.6 Catalytic Convertor\21360027.jpg

Align the catalytic convertor (2) with the tailpipe and position the gasket (3) correctly.

Graphic.entityref: Z:\VECV\SPINE\08 Pilot-work\02 Shop Manual\3019\From SME\Illustrations\5.6 Catalytic Convertor\21360028.jpg

ListItem.Para: Tighten the mounting bolt (1) on the tailpipe side using a 13 mm socket and ratchet.

Graphic.entityref: Z:\VECV\SPINE\08 Pilot-work\02 Shop Manual\3019\From SME\Illustrations\5.6 Catalytic Convertor\21360029.jpg

ListItem.Para: Torque the mounting bolt (1) between 20 to 25 Nm using a torque wrench.

ListItem.Para: Position the U-bolt (1) with the catalytic convertor support bracket (2) and tighten the mounting nuts (3) using a 13 mm spanner.

Graphic.entityref: Z:\VECV\SPINE\08 Pilot-work\02 Shop Manual\3019\From SME\Illustrations\5.6 Catalytic Convertor\21360030.jpg

Graphic.entityref: Z:\VECV\SPINE\08 Pilot-work\02 Shop Manual\3019\From SME\Illustrations\5.6 Catalytic Convertor\21360031.jpg

Graphic.entityref: Z:\VECV\SPINE\08 Pilot-work\02 Shop Manual\3019\From SME\Illustrations\5.6 Catalytic Convertor\21360033.jpg

Graphic.entityref: Z:\VECV\SPINE\08 Pilot-work\02 Shop Manual\3019\From SME\Illustrations\5.6 Catalytic Convertor\21360020.jpg

Start the engine and inspect for any exhaust leaks.
Check that the catalytic convertor (1) and pipe joints are vibration-free and secure.
Use only OEM-approved parts and torque specifications.

Position the ACM harness (1) correctly and route it along the original path.

ListItem.Para: Estimated total time for removal and installation: 1.5 hours
Fault codes may be generated if sensors are disconnected without prior power-down.
Use the authorized diagnostic tool to scan and clear fault codes after installation.
Park the vehicle on a level surface and engage the parking brake.
Turn off the ignition and wait for the EATS muffler to cool completely.
Wear safety gloves and protective eyewear.

TRow.TCell: Do not touch the EATS muffler or exhaust system while hot. Wait until components are fully cooled to prevent personal injury.

ListItem.Para: Apply anti-seize lubricant to all mounting bolts, V-band clamp threads, and sensor threads before installation.

ListItem.Para: Position the EATS muffler (1) on the special tool trolley (2) and align it to the vehicle chassis.

Graphic.entityref: Z:\VECV\SPINE\08 Pilot-work\02 Shop Manual\3019\From SME\Illustrations\5.11.7 EATS Assembly\21360046.jpg

ListItem.Para: Install the nut and washer (1) to the lower muffler bracket (2) and tighten using a 13 mm socket and ratchet.
